_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Running Broc Data Lab Irish benchmarks…

description: Evaluates Dublin & commuter-belt rental and mortgage affordability across 28 Eircode/postcode zones (2012–2026) using official RTB/ESRI Q1 2026 rents, CSO RPPI house/apartment medians, Central Bank of Ireland 4.0x/3.5x LTI caps (+0.5x lender exemption), €35,000 Help to Buy, the "Rent Trap Paradox", and 2026 Irish PAYE/USC/4.2% PRSI net pay (rentmap.datalab.broc.fi & mortgagemap.datalab.broc.fi).

buyerType.description: Central Bank buyer type: "ftb" (4.0x LTI) or "mover" (3.5x LTI).

cashSavedEur.description: Optional custom cash savings in EUR toward deposit, Stamp Duty, and legal fees.

filingStatus.description: Irish tax filing status: "single" or "couple_dual" (Joint Assessment).

grossAnnualSalary.description: Single or combined couple gross annual salary in EUR (e.g. 55000 or 110000).

interestRatePct.description: Annual mortgage interest rate % (default 3.55% CBI average; Green ~3.15%).

livingSetup.description: Rental setup: room share in 2-bed, solo 1-bed, or couple 2-bed.

postcodeOrArea.description: Optional Dublin postcode, Eircode key, or neighbourhood to spotlight (e.g. "D8", "D04", "Ranelagh", "Swords", "Blackrock", "Naas").

tenancyType.description: RTB "new" market tenancy vs "existing" sitting tenancy.

useCbiException.description: Apply +0.5x Central Bank 15% lender LTI exemption (4.5x FTB / 4.0x Mover).

useHelpToBuy.description: Apply Revenue Help to Buy grant (up to €35,000 for FTB new builds <= €500,000).

name: analyze_dublin_housing
title: Dublin Rent & Mortgage Reality Map (Broc Data Lab)
